## FSM Path-Based Test Suite for U11_Alarms

**States:**
* `BATTERY_OK`
* `BATTERY_ETA_BELOW_30MIN`
* `BATTERY_ETA_BELOW_10MIN`
* `BATTERY_ABSENT`
* `BATTERY_UNAVAILABLE`
* `BATTERY_UNCHARGEABLE`

**Transitions:**
* `START` -> `BATTERY_OK` (sensor reading)
* `BATTERY_OK` -> `BATTERY_ETA_BELOW_30MIN` (ETA calculation)
* `BATTERY_ETA_BELOW_30MIN` -> `BATTERY_ETA_BELOW_10MIN` (ETA calculation)
* `BATTERY_ETA_BELOW_10MIN` -> `BATTERY_ABSENT` (sensor reading)
* `BATTERY_ETA_BELOW_30MIN` -> `BATTERY_UNAVAILABLE` (sensor reading)
* `BATTERY_ETA_BELOW_30MIN` -> `BATTERY_UNCHARGEABLE` (sensor reading)

**Events:**
* `SENSOR_READING`
* `TIME_TICK`

**Guard Conditions:**
* `is_battery_eta_below_30min(remaining_battery)`
* `is_battery_eta_below_10min(remaining_battery)`

**Test Cases:**

| ID | Title | Req IDs | Kind | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | Battery OK | [RW-SW-120, RW-SW-121] | Positive | Battery sensor is connected and reading is available | {"remaining_battery": 50} | - | Battery OK state is reached |
| TC-002 | Battery ETA below 30min | [RW-SW-120, RW-SW-122] | Positive | Battery sensor is connected and reading is available | {"remaining_battery": 25} | - | BATTERY_ETA_BELOW_30MIN state is reached |
| TC-003 | Battery ETA below 10min | [RW-SW-120, RW-SW-124] | Positive | Battery sensor is connected and reading is available | {"remaining_battery": 5} | - | BATTERY_ETA_BELOW_10MIN state is reached |
| TC-004 | Battery absent | [RW-SW-129] | Negative | Battery sensor is disconnected | - | - | BATTERY_ABSENT state is reached |
| TC-005 | Battery unavailable | [RW-SW-129] | Negative | Battery sensor is connected but unavailable | - | - | BATTERY_UNAVAILABLE state is reached |
| TC-006 | Battery unchargeable | [RW-SW-129] | Negative | Battery sensor is connected but unchargeable | - | - | BATTERY_UNCHARGEABLE state is reached |
